title: SoapNote
description: Canonical shape for a structured SOAP (Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan) clinical note. This JSON Schema file is the source of truth for the note shape and is usable from any language with a JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 validator — the TypeScript library in this repo (src/validate.ts) is a convenience wrapper around it, not a second source of truth.

subjective.description: Patient-reported information: the reason for the visit and how the patient describes it.

chiefComplaint.description: The primary reason for the encounter, in the patient's own words or a concise clinical summary.

historyOfPresentIllness.description: Narrative history of the present illness (HPI).

examFindings.description: Structured physical exam findings, grouped by body system.

plan.description: Plan items for this encounter: medications, orders, referrals, follow-ups, patient education.

system.description: Body system reviewed, e.g. cardiovascular, respiratory, gastrointestinal.

finding.description: Free-text description of the finding, if any.

bodySystem.description: Body system examined, e.g. cardiovascular, respiratory, musculoskeletal.

finding.description: Free-text description of the exam finding.

description.description: Description of the problem or diagnosis.

codedConcept.description: Optional coded reference (e.g. ICD-10-CM, SNOMED CT). Not required — notes without coding applied yet must still validate.

detail.description: Free-text detail for this plan item.
